entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David. How can I help you today?
Hi... um, yes. I have a helmet I need to return. I'm just so confused by the website. I think I'm in the right window but I'm not sure. Can't you just help me?
Of course, I can certainly look into that return for you. To start, could you please provide me with your order number?

Thank you. I see the order for the Trail Helmet here, delivered 11 days ago. I can definitely help with this. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the helmet? Is it a technical fault or more of a personal preference?
Oh, um, a preference I guess? It's just the color. It looked different online, and it doesn't match my bike. The box is still unopened, I haven't even touched it. I just don't know what to do.
I understand completely. Sometimes the color on screen can be a bit different. Let me just pull up our current policy for you. One moment.

Alright, I've confirmed it. Since this is a standard item, our policy allows for returns within 90 days of delivery. You are well within that timeframe, so I can go ahead and approve this return for you.
Oh, really? That's it? That's such a relief! I was so worried.

Not a problem at all. We want to make sure you're happy with your gear, especially with something as important as your safety. Since you've confirmed the box unopened, that makes the process even simpler. I am sending a pre-paid return label to the email on your account right now. You should see it in the next few minutes.
Wow, thank you so much, David. You've been a great help.

You're very welcome. Once we receive the helmet back at our warehouse, you'll see a full refund to your original payment method within 3-5 business days. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again!
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
